modalities.evidence: We used fMRI in the creation of a novel neural measure of odor imagery ability

output.population: Human; Healthy / Control; ages 18–42; 47 participants with one session each
output.summary: Functional MRI of imagined odors, used to create a neural measure of odor imagery ability by decoding odor patterns in piriform primary olfactory cortex and relating them to food craving, intake and adiposity change.
